NewsArticle.Title: Internet Connection
NewsArticle.Content: An Internet Service Provider near the Dark Ages servers was unstable for 25 minutes. This is probably related to nationwide internet problem, a [Massive Fiber Cut.](http://www.zdnet.com/intweek/stories/news/0,4164,2343896,00.html) The Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load. [Learn more](http://www1.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
